questions.question: To whom did the angel announce the birth of Samson?
What was Samson to be from birth?
options: A king, chosen to rule over Israel
A prophet, called to speak for God
A priest, born to serve at the altar
A Nazirite, set apart to God
questions.answer: A Nazirite, set apart to God

questions.question: Samson's mother was barren before the angel's announcement.
Samson was to be a _____ to God from the womb; no razor was to touch his head.
The angel said Samson would begin to deliver Israel from the _____.
